company: far.ai
title: Tech Lead Manager, GPU Cluster Infrastructure
options: Remote (International) [remote]
description:
# About Us
[under: About Us] Our mission is to facilitate breakthrough AI safety research, advance global understanding of AI risks and solutions, and foster a coordinated global response.
[under: About Us] Our work is recognized globally, with publications at premier venues such as NeurIPS, ICML including a Best Paper Honorable Mention in 2026, and ICLR, and features in the Financial Times, Nature News, Wired Magazine and MIT Technology Review.
[under: About Us] We conduct pre-deployment testing on behalf of frontier developers such as OpenAI, independent evaluations for governments including the EU AI Office, and publish the AI Security Leaderboard based on our red-teaming expertise.
[under: About the Role] You'd own the platform's technical direction and roadmap, deciding what we build and how we run it in collaboration with the research teams and the rest of Foundations, and you'd hire and grow the team.
[under: What you'll do] - Hire and grow a small team of senior engineers. You set priorities and ownership, scope projects, and give regular feedback and coaching.
[under: Additional skills we're excited about] - Greenfield team-building: you've hired senior engineers and stood up on-call, incident, and review practices for a new team before.
[under: Benefits*] - Catered Meals (Berkeley Office Only) Catered lunches and dinners on workdays at our office
[under: Benefits*] *(These benefits are currently only offered to full-time US employees, we use an EOR for our international employees who have their own set of benefits for Health, Paid Leave, etc.)
[under: Logistics] If based in the USA or Singapore, you will be an employee of FAR.AI (501(c)(3) research non-profit / non-profit CLG).
[under: Logistics] Outside the USA or Singapore, you will be employed via an EOR organisation on behalf of FAR.AI or as a contractor.
[under: Logistics] - Location: Both remote and in-person (Berkeley, CA or Singapore) are possible. We sponsor visas for in-person employees, and can hire remotely in most countries. For this role we prefer candidates whose working hours overlap with Berkeley.
[under: Logistics] - Compensation: $225,000 to $325,000 per year. Compensation is determined by our salary bands and your level of experience, with adjustments for location. We also pay for work-related travel and equipment expenses, and offer catered lunch and dinner at our office in Berkeley.
[under: Logistics] - On-call: We don't run a formal on-call rotation yet. The team is spread across time zones and covers incidents during working hours. As the experiments we run get larger we expect to introduce one, and this role would take part in it.
[under: Logistics] If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact us at talent@far.ai.
[under: Logistics] Please don't email us to share your resume (it won't have any impact on our decision).
